notes.title: For users still on Windows 10
notes.content: [h3][b]Hello community,[/b][/h3][p]This message [b]concerns[/b] those using [b]Windows 10[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Quick clarification: the software works perfectly on Windows 10.[/p][p]The only issue? [b]Audio properties access rights are more restrictive than on Windows 11.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Summary for the impatient[/b][/h3][p]✅ You're on [b]Windows 11[/b] → All good, the app does everything automatically.[/p][p]⚠️ You're on [b]Windows 10[/b] → The app works, but you need to do a small manual step (we explain right after).[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What to do on Windows 10[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Right-click[/b] on [b]the sound icon[/b] in the taskbar → [b]Sounds[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Recording tab[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Select your microphone → [b]Properties[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Listen tab[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Check the "[b]Listen to this device[/b]" box[/p][/*][*][p]In the dropdown menu just below → [b]Cable Output[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Apply / Save[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677739/491a73cb5cbbfff91bae876e3a5510f0b714c2fe.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677739/d3f76365cb0e6096694e4030452cb305f3d539cc.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Why is this step necessary?[/b][/h3][p]On Windows 11, the application has the necessary rights to modify these settings automatically.[/p][p]On Windows 10, these rights are not accessible to third-party applications — hence the need to do this manually.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What about the future?[/b][/h3][p]Even though the app works on Windows 10, we still recommend planning an upgrade to Windows 11 in the coming months, because:[/p][list][*][p]Microsoft ends Windows 10 support in October 2025 (no more updates, no more security...)[/p][/*][*][p]Some future new features might not be compatible with Win10[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]👉 If you have questions, a bug to report, or just want to share your love (or hate) of Windows, join our Discord[/p][p][/p][h2][url="https://discord.com/invite/83uhygaD87"]https://discord.com/invite/83uhygaD87[/url][/h2][h2][/h2]
